issues.what: the camera barely moves, so the near granulation and the horizon never move against each other; the view reads as a flat still with no depth, and the granulation cells look frozen with no visible convective flow
issues.fix: add a slow, eased forward or lateral drift low over the surface so near cells sweep past faster than the limb, and animate the granulation (cells slowly evolving and churning)

issues.what: the coronal streamers and a red chromosphere rim appear within about four frames, while the Milky Way in the upper sky fades out at the same time; this reads as a pop and an exposure shift inside the cover, not one continuous move
issues.fix: ramp the corona, limb rim and sky exposure in over at least 30-40 frames, starting well before the cover, and keep the background star field and Milky Way at constant brightness

issues.what: a large jump in a short span: the disc goes from a dim, partly cropped limb to an overexposed bright face, prominences appear at right and the streamers jump in brightness; the color and exposure do not carry across
issues.fix: smooth the pull-back speed through this span, add intermediate scale, and match the tone-mapping and exposure on both sides of the hand-off

issues.where: loop arcade and surface texture, frames 211-214
issues.what: the magnetic loops fade to ghosts over two or three frames, and the granulation switches to a mottled facula texture (an LOD swap) instead of shrinking smoothly with distance
issues.fix: fade the loops with distance over the whole rise and cross-blend the near-field granulation into the far-field texture over many frames, keyed to the camera altitude

issues.what: there is no dive sheet and no frame sheet for the cover into the terrain view; only the terrain, rise, rise-cover and hold segments can be judged, so the round trip cannot be verified
issues.fix: render and include the dive contact sheet and a consecutive-frame sheet across the dive-to-terrain cover

issues.what: stray strands shoot up off the right loop for this one sampled frame and are gone by frame 65; the loop height also changes noticeably between frames 16, 33 and 49
issues.fix: check for a particle or strand spawn spike and smooth the loop's height animation

issues.what: the penumbra filaments around the sunspot grow from faint to strong and hard-edged over the segment, which looks like a shader parameter drifting rather than real evolution
issues.fix: keep the penumbra look constant or change it far more slowly

issues.what: during the hold the sunspots, active regions and prominences are almost exactly where they were for 180 frames; the globe looks frozen, with little visible life
issues.fix: add a slight, steady rotation or surface churn and a gentle animation of the prominences and streamers so the hold reads as a living star

issues.what: the Milky Way band moves and brightens a lot across the background while the camera eases out, more than the change in framing explains
issues.fix: lock the background sky to the camera's rotation only and keep its exposure fixed
